mapper.select: select e.id,e.paper_id,p.paper_name,e.class_id,c.class_period,p.course_id,p.stage_name,e.start_time,e.end_time, e.duration_minutes,e.invigilator_user_id, coalesce(nullif(u.real_name,''),nullif(u.nickname,''),u.username) invigilator_name,p.total_score, r.id record_id,r.status record_status,r.grading_status,r.start_time record_start_time, r.deadline_time,r.submit_time,case when e.answer_visible=1 then r.score end score from exam e inner join exam_paper p on p.id=e.paper_id inner join sys_class c on c.id=e.class_id left join sys_user u on u.id=cast(e.invigilator_user_id as unsigned) left join student_exam_record r on r.exam_id=e.id and r.student_id=#{studentId} where e.class_id=#{classId} order by e.start_time desc,e.id desc
select e.id exam_id,e.paper_id,e.class_id,e.start_time exam_start_time,e.end_time exam_end_time,e.duration_minutes from exam e where e.id=#{examId} and e.class_id=#{classId}

select r.id,r.exam_id,r.student_id,e.paper_id,e.class_id,e.start_time exam_start_time,e.end_time exam_end_time, e.duration_minutes,r.start_time,r.deadline_time,r.submit_time,r.status,r.grading_status,r.score,e.answer_visible from student_exam_record r inner join exam e on e.id=r.exam_id where r.id=#{recordId} and r.student_id=#{studentId}

select r.id,r.exam_id,r.student_id,e.paper_id,e.class_id,e.start_time exam_start_time,e.end_time exam_end_time, e.duration_minutes,r.start_time,r.deadline_time,r.submit_time,r.status,r.grading_status,r.score,e.answer_visible from student_exam_record r inner join exam e on e.id=r.exam_id where r.exam_id=#{examId} and r.student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.update: update student_exam_record set status='TIMEOUT',updated_at=now() where id=#{recordId} and status='IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.select: select r.id record_id,r.exam_id,e.paper_id,p.paper_name,e.class_id,c.class_period,p.course_id,p.stage_name, p.total_score,r.start_time,r.deadline_time,r.status record_status,r.grading_status from student_exam_record r inner join exam e on e.id=r.exam_id inner join exam_paper p on p.id=e.paper_id inner join sys_class c on c.id=e.class_id where r.id=#{recordId} and r.student_id=#{studentId}

select pq.id,pq.question_id,cast(q.question_content as char) question_content,q.question_type,q.difficulty,pq.question_score, cast(q.answer_content as char) correct_answer,cast(q.analysis_content as char) analysis_content from exam_paper_question pq inner join exam_question q on q.id=pq.question_id where pq.paper_id=#{paperId} order by pq.id

select a.id answer_id,a.question_id,cast(q.question_content as char) question_content,a.question_type,a.question_score, cast(a.answer_content as char) answer_content,cast(q.answer_content as char) correct_answer, cast(q.analysis_content as char) analysis_content,a.correct,a.score from student_exam_answer a inner join exam_question q on q.id=a.question_id where a.record_id=#{recordId} order by a.id
select id,question_id,option_key,cast(option_content as char) option_content from exam_question_option where question_id=#{questionId} order by sort_order,id
mapper.update: update student_exam_record set submit_time=#{submitTime},status='SUBMITTED',grading_status=#{gradingStatus}, score=#{score},updated_at=now() where id=#{recordId} and status='IN_PROGRESS'
